behaviors.description: The edge-case-hunter review layer flags a boundary-condition regression introduced in a diff.
behaviors.observableSuccessCriterion: A review run against a diff that flips the discount threshold's inclusive boundary (>= to >) cites the exact line where the boundary changed.

direction.scope: The findings the review layer reported for one diff arm.
direction.negativeDomain: A review run over the mutated arm whose findings never cite the planted boundary-flip line.

oracles.commentary: Resolves caught/missed by exact file:line match against the one planted defect location. The reference set's declared keys are ["file","line"]; covers-by-key itself compares a single field, so both are folded into one derived "location" string ("file:line") carried by every member and every observed finding.

planted-defects.commentary: The one boundary-condition defect this pilot plants: pkg/discount.py:17 flips >= to > (Story 45.2).

testData.setup: No fixture state to seed. The evaluator reads one diff arm (arms/clean.diff or arms/mutated.diff) and the edge-case-hunter layer prompt; both are static files under this contract's own directory.

safetyLimits: No request to any host other than the local claude CLI invocation.
requiredEvidence: The review layer's raw findings array and the run's exit status, for each arm.
